---
title: "Data summary"
---

```{r}
#| label: report-context
#| include: false
find_first <- function(paths) {
  hits <- paths[file.exists(paths)]
  if (length(hits)) hits[[1]] else NA_character_
}
load_plan <- function() {
  path <- find_first(c("config/analysis_plan.R", "../config/analysis_plan.R", "../../config/analysis_plan.R"))
  if (is.na(path)) return(NULL)
  env <- new.env(parent = baseenv())
  sys.source(path, envir = env)
  if (exists("analysis_plan", envir = env, inherits = FALSE)) get("analysis_plan", envir = env) else NULL
}
read_optional_table <- function(paths) {
  path <- find_first(paths)
  if (is.na(path)) return(NULL)
  ext <- tolower(tools::file_ext(path))
  if (ext %in% c("tsv", "txt")) read.delim(path, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) else read.csv(path, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
plan <- load_plan()
```


## Sample availability

```{r}
sample_summary <- read_optional_table(c("results/sample_summary.tsv", "../results/sample_summary.tsv", "../../results/sample_summary.tsv", "results/data_summary.tsv", "../results/data_summary.tsv", "../../results/data_summary.tsv"))
if (is.null(sample_summary)) {
  cat("Sample summary is pending. Run the domain preparation script first.")
} else {
  sample_summary
}
```

## Feature availability

```{r}
feature_summary <- read_optional_table(c("results/feature_summary.tsv", "../results/feature_summary.tsv", "../../results/feature_summary.tsv"))
if (is.null(feature_summary)) {
  cat("Feature summary is pending or included in the general data summary.")
} else {
  feature_summary
}
```

## Missingness and exclusions

Summarize missing metadata, dropped samples, dropped features, and the reason each exclusion occurred. Exclusions must trace to config, script output, or decision log.
